newsitem.title: USA: Pa. Supreme Court to hear property tax case--paper.
newsitem.headline: Pa. Supreme Court to hear property tax case--paper.

text.p: Pennsylvania Supreme Court has agreed to hear a case challenging the constitutionality of personal property taxes in the state, Philadelphia Inquirer reported Tuesday.
The suit was filed against Montgomery County by billionaire Walter Annenberg, who is seeking to have the tax abolished.

The tax is assessed on the value of stocks of companies not registered to do business in Pennsylvania. The U.S. Supreme Court struck down a similar tax in North Carolina last year as a violation of the Constitution's commerce clause.

Annenberg's case was pending in Montgomery County Court, but the state Supreme Court took up the matter under "King's Bench Authority," which allows it to take cases the justices deem of extraordinary importance to the public, the newspaper reported.
The state Supreme Court directed Annenberg's lawyers to file briefs by Feb 24. The county must file its briefs by March 17.
